units.coordinates: raw coordinate units (Node x/y); Node::euclideanDistance is not used
units.cost: edge-weight units: straight-line length x zone multiplier
units.steps: simulated navigation steps: one graph node per NavigationCore::executeNavigationStep

query: the replanner's query: from the navigator's node at block_step to the goal, on the graph with the blocked nodes removed

scenario.name: hero_replan
scenario.title: Aisle B is blocked ahead of the navigator at step 9; it replans from the node it is on

definitions.expansion: a node taken off the frontier and expanded: A* and Dijkstra when a node is settled (A* counts the goal, then stops), BFS when a node is dequeued (BFS stops when it first sees the goal, so the goal is never dequeued)
definitions.push: a node put on the frontier with a new best cost (A*, Dijkstra) or first discovered (BFS)
definitions.cost: sum of edge weights along the returned route
definitions.length: sum of straight-line segment lengths, raw coordinate units
definitions.hops: number of edges in the returned route
